skill.name: inbox-guardian-for-gmail
skill.description: Audit a Gmail inbox with local spam rules, review signed results, and apply owner-approved quarantine or Trash actions through the Gmail API.
skill.summary: Review Gmail messages before applying recoverable quarantine or Trash actions.
skill.author: glenskii

security_audit.summary: Static alerts for credentials, shell execution, reconnaissance, obfuscation, and networking are false positives caused by filenames, documentation, CSS, tests, and normal imports. The skill still has meaningful owner-authorized capabilities: it can modify Gmail, learn domain-wide block rules, and retain mailbox metadata locally.

remediation.issue: A reviewed execution can quarantine messages or move them to Gmail Trash.
remediation.suggestion: Show a final action summary and require explicit confirmation before the first Gmail mutation, especially when --trash is selected.

remediation.issue: Reviewed actions can automatically blocklist an entire return-path domain.
remediation.suggestion: Make relay learning opt-in and require separate confirmation before adding a domain. Warn when a domain may represent a shared sending service.

remediation.issue: Review and activity files retain mailbox metadata on disk.
remediation.suggestion: Add configurable retention and cleanup commands. Document backup exclusions and recommend encrypted local storage for sensitive mailboxes.

content.user_title: Review and Quarantine Gmail Spam Safely
content.value_statement: Spam review is risky when automation changes mail without clear approval. This skill audits Gmail first, then applies selected, recoverable actions through signed review files.
actual_capabilities: Connects to Gmail with the gmail.modify OAuth scope.
Audits recent Inbox message metadata without changing messages by default.
Classifies messages using authenticated sender alignment, allowlists, blocklists, keywords, and suspicious top-level domains.
Creates signed review files that expire after 24 hours.
Applies reviewed quarantine labels or moves selected messages to Gmail Trash.
Generates a local dashboard and sender-reputation database.
limitations: It reviews message metadata and configured rules, not full message intent or malware.
Trash and quarantine decisions can contain false positives and require owner review.
It supports Gmail through Google OAuth and does not support other mail providers.
It displays unsubscribe headers but never follows links or sends unsubscribe requests.

use_cases.title: Audit a Personal Inbox
use_cases.description: Review recent Gmail messages and produce a signed action list before changing mail.

use_cases.title: Maintain Sender Rules
use_cases.description: Manage trusted senders, blocked domains, suspicious keywords, and top-level-domain rules.

use_cases.title: Inspect Mailbox Activity
use_cases.description: Generate a local dashboard showing reviewed actions, learned relay domains, and trusted correspondents.

prompt_templates.title: Verify Gmail Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify my Inbox Guardian OAuth setup and report the connected Gmail account without scanning or changing messages.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Safe Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit up to 50 recent Inbox messages, explain each quarantine candidate, and do not apply any mailbox actions.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Signed Action File
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize this signed review file by sender, reason, and proposed action before I approve quarantine.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Classification Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze recent false positives and propose precise allowlist, blocklist, keyword, or suspicious-domain changes without executing them.

output_examples.input: Audit my 25 newest Inbox messages without changing anything.
output_examples.output: Audit complete. Twenty-two messages were kept, and three were proposed for quarantine. A signed review file was created for approval.

output_examples.input: Explain why this sender was flagged.
output_examples.output: The message matched a configured suspicious top-level domain. It was not changed because this was an audit-only review.

output_examples.input: Show unsubscribe options for recent newsletters.
output_examples.output: Four messages include List-Unsubscribe headers. The headers were displayed for manual review, and no links or requests were opened.

best_practices: Confirm the connected Gmail account before every first audit.
Review every proposed action and begin with quarantine instead of Trash.
Protect local OAuth, review, database, log, and dashboard files as sensitive mailbox data.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a review file that you did not generate and inspect locally.
Do not treat keyword or top-level-domain matches as proof of malicious email.
Do not share credentials, OAuth tokens, review files, logs, databases, or dashboard files.

faq.question: Does the default command change my Gmail messages?
faq.answer: No. The default command audits recent Inbox metadata and creates a signed local review file.

faq.question: What Gmail permission does the skill request?
faq.answer: It requests gmail.modify, which permits reading metadata, applying labels, archiving, and moving messages to Trash.

faq.question: Can it permanently delete messages?
faq.answer: No. It can move approved messages to Gmail Trash, where normal Gmail retention and recovery rules apply.

faq.question: Does it automatically unsubscribe from mailing lists?
faq.answer: No. It only displays List-Unsubscribe headers for manual review and never opens links or sends requests.

faq.question: Where does it store mailbox data?
faq.answer: It stores configuration, review files, activity history, and sender reputation beside the skill on the local computer.

faq.question: How does it protect approved actions?
faq.answer: Review files use HMAC signatures, expire after 24 hours, and trigger current-message reclassification before any action.
